{{Short description|British crystallographer (born 1953)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''John R. Helliwell''' (born 1953, [[Wickersley]], Yorkshire<ref>{{cite web |title=Helliwell, Prof. John Richard |url=https://www.ukwhoswho.com/display/10.1093/ww/9780199540884.001.0001/ww-9780199540884-e-19762 |website=Who's Who |publisher=A & C Black}}</ref>) is a British [[crystallography|crystallographer]] known for his pioneering work in the use of [[synchrotron radiation]] in [[X-ray crystallography#Biological macromolecular crystallography|macromolecular crystallography]].

==Education and career==
Helliwell studied [[physics]] at the [[University of York]] and obtained a [[PhD]] from the [[University of Oxford]] in 1978.<ref>[https://history.amercrystalassn.org/h-helliwell_home "Memoir - John R. Helliwell"]</ref> For many years he was closely associated with the [[Synchrotron Radiation Source]] at [[Daresbury Laboratory]], while also holding positions at the [[University of Keele]], the [[University of York]] and the [[University of Manchester]], where he is now an Emeritus Professor.<ref>[https://www.research.manchester.ac.uk/portal/john.helliwell.html "Prof John Helliwell DSc"]</ref> His research has contributed to over 100 [[Protein Data Bank]] [[crystal structure]] depositions spanning [[enzyme]]s, [[lectin]]s and [[crustacyanin]]s with ligands such as [[Saccharide (disambiguation)|saccharide]]s, [[carotenoids]] and [[metallopharmaceutical|metallodrugs]] or [[metals in medicine#Metal complexes in nuclear imaging|metalloimaging]] agents.<ref>[https://www.rcsb.org/search?request=%7B%22query%22%3A%7B%22type%22%3A%22group%22%2C%22logical_operator%22%3A%22and%22%2C%22nodes%22%3A%5B%7B%22type%22%3A%22group%22%2C%22logical_operator%22%3A%22and%22%2C%22nodes%22%3A%5B%7B%22type%22%3A%22group%22%2C%22nodes%22%3A%5B%7B%22type%22%3A%22terminal%22%2C%22service%22%3A%22text%22%2C%22parameters%22%3A%7B%22attribute%22%3A%22audit_author.name%22%2C%22operator%22%3A%22contains_phrase%22%2C%22negation%22%3Afalse%2C%22value%22%3A%22Helliwell%2C%20J.R.%22%7D%7D%5D%2C%22logical_operator%22%3A%22and%22%7D%5D%2C%22label%22%3A%22text%22%7D%5D%7D%2C%22return_type%22%3A%22entry%22%2C%22request_options%22%3A%7B%22paginate%22%3A%7B%22start%22%3A0%2C%22rows%22%3A25%7D%2C%22results_content_type%22%3A%5B%22experimental%22%5D%2C%22sort%22%3A%5B%7B%22sort_by%22%3A%22score%22%2C%22direction%22%3A%22desc%22%7D%5D%2C%22scoring_strategy%22%3A%22combined%22%7D%2C%22request_info%22%3A%7B%22query_id%22%3A%2275f6c24255f20920e1904df0e7edda62%22%7D%7D "PDB depositions authored by John R. Helliwell"]</ref>

==Awards and honours==
In 2014, the [[American Crystallographic Association]] awarded Helliwell the A. L. Patterson Award for `his pioneering contributions to the development of the instrumentation, methods and applications of synchrotron radiation in macromolecular crystallography',<ref>[https://www.cells.es/en/media/news/john-r-helliwell-alba-sac-chair-awarded-with-the-2014-aca-patterson-prize "John R. Helliwell, ALBA SAC Chair, Awarded with the 2014 ACA Patterson Prize"]</ref> and in 2015 he was awarded the Max Perutz Prize by the [[European Crystallographic Association]] for `his long, generous and fruitful dedication to developing all aspects of the use of synchrotron radiation for crystallography and for his boosting support to global development of synchrotron and neutron facilities'.<ref>[https://www.albasynchrotron.es/en/media/news/john-r-helliwell-awarded-the-max-perutz-prize-2015 "John R. Helliwell Awarded The Max Perutz Prize"]</ref><ref>[https://www.iucr.org/people/crystallographers/eighth-perutz-prize The Eighth Max Perutz Prize of the European Crystallographic Association]</ref> In 2000, he was awarded the [[Kedareswar Banerjee|Professor K. Banerjee]] Centennial Silver Medal by the [[Indian Association for the Cultivation of Science]].<ref>{{cite journal|author=[[International Union of Crystallography]]|year=2000|title=Professor K. Banerjee Endowment Lecture Silver Medal|journal=[[Journal of Applied Crystallography]]|doi=10.1107/S0021889800017672|volume=33|issue=6|pages=1450|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Helliwell, J.R.|year=2002|title=New opportunities in biological and chemical crystallography|journal=[[Journal of Synchrotron Radiation]]|doi=10.1107/S0909049501018465|volume=9|issue=1|pages=1–8|hdl=10821/5714|hdl-access=free}}</ref>

John Helliwell was made an Honorary Member of the Slovenian [[National Institute of Chemistry]] in 1996,<ref>[https://arhiv.ki.si/index.php?id=147&L=1 "Honorary members of the National Institute of Chemistry"]</ref> a Fellow of the [[American Crystallographic Association]] in 2015,<ref>[https://www.amercrystalassn.org/fellows "Fellows of the American Crystallographic Association | Class of 2015"]</ref> an honorary member of the [[British Biophysical Society]] in 2016<ref>[https://britishbiophysics.org/about/ "About the British Biophysical Society"]</ref> and an honorary member of the British Crystallographic Association in 2019.<ref>[https://www.crystallography.org.uk/membership/honorary/ "Honorary Members of the BCA"]</ref> He is also a member of the [[Royal Academy of Sciences and Arts of Barcelona]].<ref>[https://www.racab.cat/en/ "The Academy - Reial Acadèmia de Ciències i Arts de Barcelona"]</ref>

John Helliwell is a Fellow of the [[Fellow of the Institute of Physics|Institute of Physics]], the [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry|Royal Society of Chemistry]] and the [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Biology|Royal Society of Biology]].<ref name="WDC">[http://scripts.iucr.org/cgi-bin/detailed_display?&id=2800 "World Directory of Crystallographers - Professor John Richard Helliwell"]</ref>

==Service to the scientific community==
John Helliwell served as Editor in Chief of [[Acta Crystallographica]] and Chairman of the [[International Union of Crystallography]] Commission on Journals from 1996 to 2005,<ref name="JAC">{{cite journal|author=[[International Union of Crystallography]]|year=1996|title=New Editor-in-Chief of IUCr journals|journal=[[Journal of Applied Crystallography]]|doi=10.1107/S002188989609961X|volume=29|issue=5|pages=614|doi-access=free}}</ref> and in numerous other roles at the [[International Union of Crystallography|IUCr]];<ref name="WDC" /> he was Chair of the IUCr Committee on Data from 2017 to 2023.<ref>[https://www.iucr.org/iucr/governance/advisory-committees/committee-on-data "Committee on Data"]</ref> Helliwell was interviewed by the Main Editors of ''Acta Crystallographica Section F: Structural Biology Communications''.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cTEEOKEISDA "Interview with John Helliwell by the Main Editors of Acta Crystallographica Section F: Structural Biology Communications"]</ref> He was also President of the [[European Crystallographic Association]] from 2006 to 2009.<ref>[https://ecanews.org/archive2019/composition-of-eca-executive-committees/ "Composition of ECA Executive Committees"]</ref>
